description: This file defines the interface IGrainReferenceRuntime, which specifies runtime operations related to grain references in the Orleans framework. It includes method signatures for invoking remote grain methods asynchronously and synchronously, as well as casting grain objects to specific interfaces.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a method on a grain, returning a value of type T.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a method on a grain without returning a value.

methods.name: InvokeMethod
methods.description: Invokes a void method on a grain without waiting for a response.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Converts a grain to a specified interface type.
